A little help
along the way.

Progress, purchases, or a puzzle that feels stuck. Here is where to start.

Restore a purchase

  1. Use the same Apple or Google store account that made the purchase.
  2. Open CASCADE Settings and choose Restore purchases.
  3. Allow the store and receipt verifier to finish. If there is a connection error, reconnect and try again.

Eligible non-consumable removal of automatic ads can be restored. Spent coin packs are not recredited. Cloud progress and remaining inventory require a successfully linked and synchronized game account; local-only progress is not a cloud backup.

Something is not working?

Include your platform, app version, what you tapped, and a screenshot if helpful. For purchases, include the order reference; for connected progress, include the game identifier if available. Never send your password or full payment details.

Email CASCADE support

shapeinc25@gmail.com

Need a refund?

Refunds are handled under your store’s rules and consumer law. Use Apple’s refund instructions or Google Play’s refund instructions.

Quiet the motion or reminders

The game’s Sound & motion settings include Reduced motion. Reminders can be disabled in the game and your device settings. This site has its own Pause motion control.

Privacy or account questions?

Account & data requests explains local and cloud deletion. Privacy Policy and Terms of Use cover the details.
